extraction.name: HELVIPAD
extraction.description: HELVIPAD is a real-world dataset for omnidirectional stereo depth estimation, featuring 40K video frames from indoor and outdoor video sequences. It includes accurate depth and disparity labels collected using two 360° cameras in a top-bottom setup and a LiDAR sensor.
extraction.creator: Mehdi Zayene (EPFL); Jannik Endres (EPFL; TU Darmstadt); Albias Havolli (EPFL); Charles Corbière (EPFL); Salim Cherkaoui (EPFL); Alexandre Kontouli (EPFL); Alexandre Alahi (EPFL)
extraction.citeAs: Mehdi Zayene, Jannik Endres, Albias Havolli, Charles Corbière, Salim Cherkaoui, Alexandre Kontouli, Alexandre Alahi. HELVIPAD : A Real-World Dataset for Omnidirectional Stereo Depth Estimation. arXiv:2411.18335v2, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected across indoor and outdoor scenes on a university campus using a custom-built, remotely controlled robot chassis equipped with two Ricoh Theta V 360° cameras in a top-bottom setup and an Ouster OS1-64 LiDAR sensor.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Due to the sparse nature of LiDAR point clouds compared to high-resolution camera images, ground-truth depth labels initially cover only a fraction of the total pixels.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data consists of 4K/UHD equirectangular images at 30 fps (3840 × 1920 pixels) from two Ricoh Theta V cameras and 3D point clouds at 10 fps from an Ouster OS1-64 LiDAR sensor.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Depth and disparity labels were automatically generated by projecting LiDAR 3D point clouds onto equirectangular images, followed by a fully automated depth completion pipeline to increase label density.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: LiDAR-to-Image Mapping Optimization algorithm; fully automated depth completion pipeline
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The temporal aggregation approach for depth completion is limited for fast-moving objects like cars; the depth completion method does not provide labels for pixels at object boundaries.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset captures human pedestrian activity and includes pedestrians in the video sequences.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Developing and benchmarking omnidirectional depth estimation models capable of navigating in human environments; assessing the robustness of depth estimation methods to diverse lighting conditions and depth ranges.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: Missing depth values are interpolated on spherical grid points by using temporally aggregated point clouds.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Training data is augmented with a significantly increased label density using depth completion, and photometric data augmentation is applied during training.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images, depth maps, and disparity maps are cropped to remove unnecessary borders (such as sky and ground) and downsized from a width of 1024 pixels to 512. Additionally, query points exceeding an uncertainty criterion or an out-of-distribution threshold are filtered.
